decisive_items: Urticarial lesions visible on right knee and popliteal fossa
response.rationale: R2 has direct raw support for the diagnosis of urticaria, including generalized distribution and specific lesions, while R4 only provides a temporal link to vaccination without naming the diagnosis. R2 is more complete and specific.

rejected.why: Redundant completion of R2 with no additional raw support.
Only supports urticaria and angioedema, not specific to mast cell activation disorder.
Only supports angioedema, not the primary diagnosis of urticaria.
Only supports history of autoimmune disease, not direct evidence of autoimmune urticaria.
